doc: Walks a nul-terminated byte string in place. For each character c (until the terminating 0), looks up a per-character flag byte in the 256-entry table D_800714B0[c]; if bit 0x10 is set, replaces the character in the string with (c + 0x31). Returns the original string pointer unchanged.

globals.name: D_800714B0
globals.decl: extern u8 D_800714B0[0x100]; /* 256-entry per-character flag/classification table, indexed by unsigned byte value; bit 0x10 checked here, bits 0x30/0x40/0x80 checked by sibling func_8004E188 */
